messages:
Diego S: Alert — p95 latency for eu-west-generation spiked to ~950ms, error rate (5xx) up to 9%. Alerting for capacity pressure on gpu-pool-eu-1. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/eu/gpu-pool-eu-1
IncidentBot: Paging on-call SRE: @Marta R. Severity: S2. Trigger reason: sustained p95 > 400ms for 10m and 5xx > 5%.
Marta R: I’m on it. Checking autoscaler and smart-routing metrics now. Can someone post recent traffic composition (tiers + regions)?
Raj P: grabbing rt metrics. Early read: a sustained burst of long-context requests from two orgs — both free/trial tiers sending 8k token prompts ( -> kv cache churn ), and a spike in client parallelism. Batching inefficiency + kernel fallback causing higher CPU on host.
Priya L: Support queue shows ~12 customers reporting timeouts in EU region, mostly low-tier demos. No enterprise customers reported yet.
Alex G: Heap of smallish long-tail requests prevents efficient batching. We can mitigate with smart-routing changes: 1) gate free/trial traffic to cheaper model variant; 2) lower max tokens per request for free tier; 3) apply temporary quota throttle per org.
Marta R: Agree. Plan: implement surgical tier gating and quota change for 10m window, monitor. Raj, can you craft the routing rule and a quick fallback path?
Raj P: Drafting rule. Proposed policy (eu-west):
```
policy: eu-smart-gate-2026-03-15
match: region == "eu-west" && tier == "free"
actions:
  - route_to: model-gpt-small-quant
  - max_tokens: 1024
  - rps_limit_per_org: 8
  - fallback: allow-to-prod-variant if queue_depth < 10
```
I’ll stage it in canary first (10% of free traffic), then bump to 100% after 3m if metrics improve.
Marta R: Make sure we tag this action for audit and include a rollback window. Also add a cost vs latency note in the commit message.
Raj P: Executing canary now. /deploy-route --policy eu-smart-gate-2026-03-15 --canary 10 --author raj
IncidentBot: Route change submitted by Raj P. RunID: run_1845678920. Canary scope: 10% free-tier eu-west.
Priya L: Noted. I’ll prep customer comms for affected demo users if we need a longer mitigation.
Diego S: Early telemetry: p95 down to ~480ms, 5xx to 4.2% after 90s. Canary looks promising.
Alex G: Recommend also enabling token-bucket shaping on model-gpt-small-quant to prevent head-of-line blocking: shape_rate=20rps, bucket=30.
Raj P: Applied shaping on canary path. /apply-shape --model model-gpt-small-quant --region eu-west --rate 20 --burst 30
Marta R: Metrics check at +4m post-canary: p95 370ms, 5xx 2.1%, request queue depth on gpu-pool-eu-1 dropped 54%. Good. Moving canary->100%.
Raj P: Promoting canary to 100% for free tier. /promote-route --policy eu-smart-gate-2026-03-15 --to 100
IncidentBot: Promotion complete. RunID: run_1845678965.
Priya L: Support update: timeouts reported dropped to 2, both from the same sandbox org. Reached out.
SupportBot: Tickets affected: #3421, #3427. Priority: low. Customers informed about temporary shaping.
Diego S: Any enterprise impact?
Marta R: None observed. Enterprise routes untouched. No SLA breaches logged for paying customers.
Raj P: One caveat: some internal analytics jobs hitting generation endpoint experienced higher latencies due to reroute — pushing to schedule batch windows.
Alex G: Will add a rule to exclude internal key ids from free-tier gating. Quick command:
```
policy-exclude: [internal-service-*]
apply: eu-smart-gate-2026-03-15
```
Applied.
Marta R: Handing off to Raj for steady-state monitoring and follow-up mitigation. I need to step away for an Ops call. @Raj P you own incident now.
Raj P: Acknowledged. I’ll monitor for 30m and keep this thread updated. Next steps: 1) revert gating after 30m if stable, 2) create follow-up PSIRT with root-cause signals (long-context abuse + lack of per-org token caps for free tier), 3) recommend runtime change to detect KV cache churn and proactively apply per-request token limits.
Priya L: I’ll draft customer-safe message and include the affected sandbox IDs and timeframe.
Diego S: Thanks. Logging action items: [ACTION] engineering: add per-tier token cap config (owner: Raj). [ACTION] product: review free-tier default max_tokens (owner: Priya). [ACTION] SRE: add alert for KV cache miss rate (owner: Marta).
Raj P: Noted. Leaving a short status update for handoff: current p95 320ms, 5xx 1.9%, queue depth stable. Retaining gating at modest limits until noon UTC.
IncidentBot: Incident status: mitigated; monitoring. Severity downgraded to S3.
Marta R: Thanks team — good coordinated mitigation. I’ll take the postmortem once I’m back online.
SupportBot: Customer comms draft ready: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/1845678901-comms (Priya please review).
Priya L: Will review and send.
Diego S: Closing notes: include specific replay window and sample traces for the postmortem. Also note the need for smarter routing policies that consider sequence-length distribution (not just tier+region).
Raj P: Affirmative. I’ll collect traces and add to the incident folder.
Marta R: handing back to normal ops. Ending active paging. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
_meta: Slack thread stored as continuous message string; messages prefixed by sender's name; includes incident bot and support bot messages for realism.
